svg.aria-label: An AI agent sends a command over Wi-Fi (MCP) to an ESP32-S3, which types it on the target computer as a USB keyboard; the output comes back over USB serial and returns to the agent with the exit code.
svg.text: Claude Code or any MCP client
BIOS · login · shell · no network needed
One USB cable. Nothing to install on the target.
Works where SSH can't: no network, broken drivers, boot menus.
